caption.description: The caption of the InputRadio appears beneath the label in a lighter text color.

intent.description: Colors the border of the empty circle. The selected radio always uses the accent color.

stage.description: Sets the radio as "checked" or "unchecked", overriding checked. Omit it inside a RadioGroup, which drives the selection itself.

classes.description:
Class names for the internal elements: root, labelCaptionContainer, label,
caption, radioButton, radioCheckedIcon, radioCheckedIconDot, and
radioDefaultIcon.

value.description:
The value a RadioGroup compares against to decide whether this radio is
selected. It also backs the label and caption element ids, so give every
radio a unique one.

radioProps.description: Directly pass these props to the underlying MUI radio.
